status: Public source prerelease and website live; v0.1.14-alpha.1 release candidate verified

components.evidence_level: Public source prerelease; OLED kit verified over USB, Wi-Fi and an always-on relay; native Grok Bot calls observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: The v0.1.14-alpha.1 hub release candidate records gateway 0.1.0a13 on PyPI (owner-approved trusted publishing on 14 October 2026; files match the GitHub release's SHA256SUMS) with ESP32 SDK v0.2.0-alpha.14, Linux SDK v0.1.0-alpha.6 and Home Assistant v0.1.0-alpha.5. Adds the Mac-free route guide, the How it works page and the Phase 9 record; ADR 009 stage 1 is accepted. On 13 October 2026 the owner's kit reached a gateway on an always-on Linux server, and Grok Bot on the iPhone, on cellular, showed text on it while the Mac slept (hub docs/verification/mac-free-route-2026-10-13.md). One kit and one server; independent reproduction is not claimed.

components.evidence_level: Simulated; LAN and relay device listeners used by one physical kit; native Grok Bot calls through serve --oauth observed on the owner's setup
components.checks: 295 tests (Python 3.11 to 3.14), Ruff and the release workflow's fresh-download SHA256SUMS check passed; PyPI 0.1.0a13 matches SHA256SUMS. Adds serve --device-listen, device-cert, wifi-provision --gateway/--ca, the relay host example and a zero-calibration refusal. On 13 October 2026 the relay ran as a systemd user unit on a real Linux server and recovered 24 s after a reboot with no login (hub docs/verification/mac-free-route-2026-10-13.md). The container example was checked only on a Mac.

55 tests passed, including the gateway integration tests against gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10; Ruff, package builds and twine check passed. The gateway extra pins gateway v0.1.0-alpha.10, so the SDK and its gateway install from PyPI. No fresh Linux container, systemd or Raspberry Pi run in this release.

components.evidence_level: Host simulated; four firmware builds compiled; OLED kit physically accepted on one board over USB and Wi-Fi
components.checks: Host CTest suites (10/10, including wifi_relay), the contract check and the Wi-Fi firmware build passed. Alpha.14 accepts a relay's DNS name, verifies TLS by name, shows Relay... and Relay name?, adds reconnect jitter and restarts the join timer after a Wi-Fi drop. On 13 October 2026 the owner's kit reached the relay by name; a wrong CA was refused and a revoked token showed Token rejected (hub docs/verification/mac-free-route-2026-10-13.md).

Unit tests, Ruff, package builds and twine check passed; the fixture probe reports zero tool calls and resource reads. Adds the release workflow; no probe behavior change. No real Home Assistant installation or Grok Bot connection was tested.

firmware.status: build verified; hardware and Grok pending; unpublished
